extends: design.json (issue #35 single-teacher protocol); same collector, roster, claims and trainer boundary
question: Does bounded committee-mean auxiliary supervision from the twenty retained Pilkwang v15 members change a solo public-input DINOv3 student relative to the identical ordinary student and to the identical single-teacher arm?
committee: pilkwang/rsna-knee-baseline-v1/v15, all twenty retained manifest members in manifest order; frozen, logits-only
inspection_receipt: initiative/audits/public-teacher-committee-prefix-20261013-v1 (root; bound by SHA in the evidence binding, not present in this change)

shared_prefix.forward: tools/research/public_teacher_evidence/committee.py: embeddings + blocks 0-5 once per bitwise-identical normalized input, then each member's blocks 6-11, layernorm, original pooling and SlotHead via its own original Model.forward/predict_member
acceptance_before_root_accepts: each member's original fingerprint passes on its full graph (teacher.build_teacher)
Committee.verify_fingerprints: shared-view fingerprint bitwise equal to full graph for all twenty
Committee.collect_study(check_full=True) on all eight accepted render studies: every member's window logits and probabilities bitwise equal full vs shared, same device/precision/backend
any inequality: report the limitation and collect with forward=full_graph; never relax

evidence.cap_status: proposed; root funding receipt SHA required before any write

auxiliary: combined = label_loss + w * effective_batch_loss(student_logits, committee_mean, confidence, confidence_counts); confidence = clamp(|2*mean-1| - 2*between_model_std, 0, 1); fitting studies only; absent studies weight 0
not_used_as_confidence: across-window spread (anatomical, not epistemic); eight original studies showed zero predeclared sparse-high-window cases, so focal suppression stays unproven and is not part of this design (issue #37 owns it)
evaluation: Existing 1156-study outer evaluation with accepted labels only; committee never scores, selects or filters evaluation studies; no teacher or committee at student inference
primary_endpoint: paired macro AUC difference committee vs ordinary with the repository's existing paired bootstrap; committee vs single_teacher secondary; per-target results reported, including negative and undefined
not_claimable: clean held-out teacher/student comparison (teacher training roster unknown)
preconditions_before_any_fit: root committee prefix inspection receipt committed
root funding of the 64 MiB evidence cap
trainer integration reviewed in a separate change
release: private only; no submission of any diagnostic model
